data.narrative:
DG Matrix is a Series A climate and energy company founded by Haroon Inam and Subhashish Bhattacharya, having raised over $100M to date. The sector comprises 9 private peers and 1 public comparable (LNZA), though a narrow peer set at identical stage and valuation tier remains limited, reducing reliance on peer multiples.

Stage-progression analysis, the primary applicable method, uses the company's $100M in total raised as a valuation proxy and applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A advancement to subsequent rounds. This yields an implied valuation of $200M. A peer-median approach was not executable due to insufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables within the climate and energy sector meeting quantitative thresholds; while nine sector peers exist, none satisfied the three-datapoint minimum when filtered for stage and tier alignment.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $170M (low) to $230M (high), with a median of $200M. This single-method result carries material uncertainty around stage-step dynamics and the representativeness of the 2.0x multiplier for this particular company and market cycle. Additional primary data on recent climate-tech Series A outcomes and DG Matrix's specific growth metrics and capital efficiency would refine this estimate.
